_about: Editorial data for the Argentina country hub (/country/argentina/) and its health page, written in task 174. Figures are never stored here: pages take them from src/data/profiles/ARG.json and the generated series.
name: Argentina

factChecks.against: FCDO Argentina travel advice, Getting help: ambulance 107, fire 100, police 911 or 101
factChecks.label: emergency numbers 911 or 101 police, 107 ambulance, 100 fire

verification.what: Every statistic row (value, year, world rank) on the page, every number in the text, title, description and JSON-LD, and every claim in the story and FAQ (ranks, comparisons, trends, our counts); the build also asserts each claim (assertClaim); driving side and emergency numbers by hand (factChecks)
verification.against: Original UN WPP 2024, UN WUP 2025 and World Bank WDI files read by scripts/verify/batch-174.py (independent of the site code); energy rows by check-energy and country facts by check-facts against their original files

verification.what: Every figure in the text, cards, Key facts, title, description, JSON-LD, statistic rows and every cell of the yearly table; every claim in the story, chart captions and FAQ (ranks, comparisons, trends, our counts)
verification.against: Original World Bank WDI files read by scripts/verify/batch-174.py; check-country-pages compares the table and CSV with the World Bank values
